settings.heading: No scoop. No mix. No mystery math.
settings.text:
The capsule experience should be compact and legible: exact contents, exact count, exact label, and a lot-linked report. The module is ready; final capsule records and photography are not.

Strengths and counts must stay separate in the interface so shoppers never confuse an amount declaration with package quantity.

settings.heading: Every capsule fact belongs on the record.
settings.text: Approved product metafields will supply the final facts, ingredients, directions, and warnings for the selected capsule variant.

settings.question: What do the amount options mean?
settings.answer: [FINAL LABEL REQUIRED: exact approved definition for each amount declaration.] The interface will not translate amount into a guaranteed experience.

settings.question: What is the difference between strength and count?
settings.answer: Strength describes an approved amount declaration; count describes how many capsules are in the package. Final product records must keep them distinct.

settings.question: How many capsules should I take?
settings.answer: [FINAL LABEL REQUIRED: exact suggested-use text and interval.] Follow the selected product label and do not treat formats or concentrations as interchangeable.

settings.question: Where is the batch report?
settings.answer: [FINAL COA REQUIRED: finished-product, lot-linked capsule report and stable public URL.]

settings.question: Are capsules available now?
settings.answer: This template is a development surface. Availability must come from a published Shopify product with approved labels, inventory, pricing, and eligibility.

settings.heading: Capsule questions, without the guesswork.
settings.text: Final records control every strength, count, serving, price, and availability statement.

settings.heading: Connect the real lineup before selling it.
settings.text: Approved variants, labels, inventory, prices, media, eligibility, and lot reports are all required before this template leaves development.
